Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our discussion, I'd like to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan to align owners and a timeline for the evaluation so your security team can review SOC 2 and data-handling controls while your product team runs the POC.

Proposed high-level MAP (suggested 3-week cadence):
- Week 1: GRC introductions, SOC 2 artifact request, access plan for POC data samples
- Week 2: Evidence upload + security review, POC runs (sample traffic), law/legal procurement touchpoint
- Week 3: Final Q/A, debrief, and go/no-go decision (pricing/contract conversations if moving forward)

Can you confirm the security/GRC point of contact on your side, and whether Orbit prefers evidence via SFTP or a shared Drive? I attached a brief SOC 2 summary from our side to speed triage.

I’m looping in Sergio (AM) and Rachel (security reviewer) from Redwood so we can coordinate evidence handoff and timelines. Suggested next step: 30-min MAP kickoff call next Tuesday (Feb 17) — does 10:00 PT work?

Thanks,

Hi Lisa —

Appreciate the template and the timeline. Quick answers to the two points you raised:

1) Telemetry & retention: Redwood's hosted service retains request/response telemetry for 90 days by default; we can configure shorter retention on Dedicated/Private deployments. Retention policies (and purging processes) are documented and part of our SOC 2 scope.

2) Token-level logs: We do surface per-request metadata (timestamps, model used, request id, token counts) in logs; full request/response payloads are protected and only accessible to authorized system administrators under strict change-control. We can provide an auditor-facing readme and an export of allowed log fields for your review.

Action items I can own this week before the kickoff:
- Provide a one-page auditor note describing telemetry retention and access controls (will upload to the Drive link)
- Share a checklist of SOC 2 artifacts that map to the Orbit template

Camila — I'll drop the artifacts into the shared Drive by EOD Mon so your team and Orbit can review ahead of Tuesday.

-Rachel
